entries.speaker: Male Pedestrian
entries.en: What's up with that old geezer?

entries.speaker: Female Pedestrian
entries.en: Is he... crying?

entries.speaker: Madarame
entries.en: I... I have committed crimes that are[n]unbecoming of an artist.

entries.speaker: Madarame
entries.en: Plainly put... I, um... plagiarized work...

entries.speaker: Madarame
entries.en: I-I... tainted this... this country's art[n]world... and... even "Sayuri"!

entries.speaker: Madarame
entries.en: ...H-How could I... I possibly... apologize[n]to—to everyone for... for what I've done...[n]Aaaah...

entries.speaker: Male Pedestrian
entries.en: He's crying way too much...

entries.speaker: Newscaster
entries.en: ...And that was from the urgent apology[n]conference by Madarame that took place[n]just a moment ago.

entries.speaker: Newscaster
entries.en: After reporting to the association,[n]Madarame has agreed to the police's[n]request to turn himself in.

entries.speaker: Female Pedestrian
entries.en: Wasn't he on TV the other day?

entries.speaker: Newscaster
entries.en: On top of charges of abuse to his pupils,[n]Madarame is under suspicion of claiming[n]their works as his own.

entries.speaker: Newscaster
entries.en: Some doubt the validity that his maiden[n]work "Sayuri" was stolen, believing it was[n]used for fraud.

entries.speaker: Newscaster
entries.en: This large-scale criminal act has caused[n]a great shock to the art world, and...

entries.speaker: Female Pedestrian
entries.en: That old man's done for.

entries.speaker: Newscaster
entries.en: After the conference, Madarame was[n]taken to a police hospital for interrogation[n]due to his age.

entries.speaker: Newscaster
entries.en: However, initial psych evaluations state[n]that he is mentally sound and likely[n]responsible for his actions.

entries.speaker: Male Pedestrian
entries.en: There's no need to be nice to an old[n]geezer like that.

entries.speaker: Male Pedestrian
entries.en: Why'd he spill the beans himself?[n]Doesn't that seem weird?

entries.speaker: Newscaster
entries.en: Also, a group calling themselves the[n]Phantom Thieves posted a dubious note[n]at Madarame's exhibit.

entries.speaker: Newscaster
entries.en: The police will investigate their relation[n]to this case, but for now, did not identify[n]them as suspects.

entries.speaker: Male Pedestrian
entries.en: Phantom Thieves? Do these bandits have[n]somethin' to do with that old geezer's[n]apology?

entries.speaker: Female Pedestrian
entries.en: Ohh, I've heard of them before. They[n]supposedly steal evil hearts; it's why[n]the culprits apologize.

entries.speaker: Female Pedestrian
entries.en: Wait, what? Steal hearts?[n]That's impossible though.

entries.speaker: Male Pedestrian
entries.en: But I feel like I saw somethin' about that[n]online too. They sent out a calling card[n]for real.

entries.speaker: Male Pedestrian
entries.en: So it was like, "We're going to take your[n]heart?" That's impressive if someone[n]really did that.

entries.speaker: Pleasant Boy
entries.en: Phantom Thieves, huh?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Phantom Thieves again...
